target: Transfer the historical graph-tautology Formula-Caching lower bound to JANUS-FC_local with Policy-0A's deterministic one-pass local Resolution rule.

residual_raw_order_witness.failure_mode: One local pass can falsify every critical total order compatible only with the reconstructed entry assignment.

historical_measure.source_object: Novel branch comparing vertices in different connected components of the current partial-order Hasse diagram.

resource_decomposition.branch_merge: Component reduction caused by the explicit branch comparison.
resource_decomposition.pre_unit_merge: Component reduction caused by unit propagation in the child residual before cache lookup/local Resolution.
resource_decomposition.post_local_unit_merge: Component reduction caused by units exposed after the registered local Resolution pass.
resource_decomposition.cache_reuse: Reuse of a completed exact residual judgement without replaying descendant merges.

missing_lemmas: Characterize when Policy-0A assignments remain acyclic partial orders before the historical novelty test.
Charge every pre-unit and post-local-Resolution component merge to a bounded proof event.
Prove that cache equality preserves the historical restriction label or give a polynomial label transformation.
Show that early contradictions cannot bypass the 2^(n-2) restriction count without paying superpolynomial local proof work.
Normalize the final bound to actual graph-tautology CNF encoding length.
falsification_conditions: Unit or local-Resolution merges can collapse all Hasse components with polynomial charged work on the full family.
Exact cache reuse identifies exponentially many historical restrictions with no polynomially checkable distinguishing label.
The historical novelty invariant depends on a property violated by Policy-0A residuals and no polynomial repair exists.
A polynomial JANUS-FC_local execution family is constructed for graph tautologies.
claim_boundary: C024 has falsified one naive witness reconstruction and identified the historical novelty measure. It has not transferred the graph-tautology lower bound to Policy-0A and does not resolve P versus NP.
